notes.title: Merry XMAS, Machizzle is now Free!
notes.content:
As a Christmas gift from iNFINITE Producttion, the studio behind Desert Ride, [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1301770/Machizzle/]Machizzle [/url] is now free. 

Machizzle is a physics-bending puzzle for VR. There is a 80 levels long campaign that will keep your brain occupied for hours! You need to complete a path for your physics based ball to follow. And you get tired of regular laws of physics, you can play with portal or gravity as well. But, you don't see it for your self? Did I mention the game is now FREE?

notes.title: Speed and Scream released
notes.content: Hi guys, thank to everyone who tried this ride and enjoyed. We're listening to feedback and are happy to announce that Speed and Scream collection, spiritual successor to this ride is now available on Steam. The collection contains 4 rides, all of them are longer and smoother than this one. Two of them are also synced with music. So check it out and let us know what do you think :)

notes.title: Desert Ride released on Steam
notes.content: This is a short experiemental rollercoaster ride where I wanted to test how would it feel to have a rollercoaster synchronized with music. The entire exprerience is 91 seconds and that's all for now. There might be more based on feedback, so I'm looking forward to hear from you! Enjoy!
